),
q3_2025_26_sales AS (
  SELECT DISTINCT fsl.store_key, ds.store_id, ds.store_name, ds.region
  FROM fact_sales_line fsl
  JOIN dim_store ds ON fsl.store_key = ds.store_key
  WHERE fsl.sale_date BETWEEN '2025-10-27' AND '2026-01-25'
)
SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT q3_2024_25_sales.store_id) as stores_in_q3_2024_25,
       COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN q3_2025_26_sales.store_id IS NOT NULL THEN q3_2024_25_sales.store_id END) as lfl_stores
FROM q3_2024_25_sales
LEFT JOIN q3_2025_26_sales ON q3_2024_25_sales.store_id = q3_2025_26_sales.store_id

-- Like-for-like sales by region comparing Q3 FY2024/25 to Q3 FY2025/26
WITH q3_2024_25_stores AS (
  SELECT DISTINCT ds.store_id
  FROM fact_sales_line fsl
  JOIN dim_store ds ON fsl.store_key = ds.store_key
  WHERE fsl.sale_date BETWEEN '2024-10-28' AND '2025-01-26'
),
q3_sales_2024_25 AS (
  SELECT ds.region, SUM(fsl.net_amount) as net_sales_2024_25
  FROM fact_sales_line fsl
  JOIN dim_store ds ON fsl.store_key = ds.store_key
  WHERE fsl.sale_date BETWEEN '2024-10-28' AND '2025-01-26'
    AND ds.store_id IN (SELECT store_id FROM q3_2024_25_stores)
  GROUP BY ds.region
),
q3_sales_2025_26 AS (
  SELECT ds.region, SUM(fsl.net_amount) as net_sales_2025_26
  FROM fact_sales_line fsl
  JOIN dim_store ds ON fsl.store_key = ds.store_key
  WHERE fsl.sale_date BETWEEN '2025-10-27' AND '2026-01-25'
    AND ds.store_id IN (SELECT store_id FROM q3_2024_25_stores)
  GROUP BY ds.region
)
SELECT 
  COALESCE(s24.region, s26.region) as region,
  ROUND(s24.net_sales_2024_25, 2) as net_sales_q3_2024_25,
  ROUND(s26.net_sales_2025_26, 2) as net_sales_q3_2025_26,
  ROUND((s26.net_sales_2025_26 - s24.net_sales_2024_25) / s24.net_sales_2024_25 * 100, 2) as lfl_growth_pct
FROM q3_sales_2024_25 s24
FULL OUTER JOIN q3_sales_2025_26 s26 ON s24.region = s26.region
ORDER BY region

SELECT ds.store_id, ds.store_name, 
       COUNT(*) as line_count,
       SUM(fsl.net_amount) as total_sales
FROM fact_sales_line fsl
JOIN dim_store ds ON fsl.store_key = ds.store_key

GROUP BY ds.store_id, ds.store_name
ORDER BY ds.store_id
